xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2831: Issues pane sorts issue IDs lexicographically — PAN-532 renders after PAN-2822

plan.title: Issues pane sorts issue IDs lexicographically — PAN-532 renders after PAN-2822
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Issue lists across the dashboard sort issue IDs with plain string comparison (`a.issueId.localeCompare(b.issueId)` or default Array.sort()), so PAN-532 sorts after PAN-2822 because '5' > '2' lexicographically. The operator reads the Issues pane ordering as random. The same flat comparator is duplicated per-surface (Issues pane projectsData, MergePolicySection, useSearch tiebreak, HomePage workspace cards, server routes/projects and resource-discovery), so any per-surface fix would leave the others broken and lets the bug recur.
narratives.Proposal: Add one shared numeric-aware comparator `compareIssueIds(a: string, b: string): number` in packages/contracts (importable by both the frontend and the dashboard server), implemented with a module-level pinned collator: `new Intl.Collator('en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })`. This orders embedded numeric segments by value (PAN-532 < PAN-2822), handles Rally-style ids (F29698), non-numeric suffixes (PAN-532-hotfix after PAN-532), and falls back to sane string order for non-conforming ids — with no hand-rolled parsing. Then replace every issue-id sort call site with the shared comparator: frontend projectsData.ts (the Issues pane), MergePolicySection.tsx, useSearch.ts (score tiebreak only), HomePage.tsx, and server routes/projects.ts + resource-discovery.ts. Surfaces that sort by other keys (priority/recency/name) keep their existing primary sort; only the issue-id comparisons change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT change Pipeline view ordering (PipelineView.tsx comparePipelineIssues sorts by priority then updatedAt — no issue-id sort exists there and none is added)
- Do NOT change agent-id sorting in src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/workAgents.ts:31 (those are agent ids, not issue ids)
- Do NOT change the query-key normalization sort in ZoneCOverviewTabs/queries.ts:577 (cache-key determinism only, never rendered)
- Do NOT change pipeline-run-metrics.ts completedIssueIds sort (stats sample ordering, not a rendered issue list)
- Do NOT change kanban board ordering (server-ranked, drag semantics)
- Do NOT reorder projects themselves (project list stays sorted by name)

autoDecisions.summary: Comparator lives in packages/contracts (new src/issue-sort.ts, exported from index.ts), not the frontend lib.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue offers 'frontend lib (or contracts)'; server-side call sites exist (routes/projects.ts, resource-discovery.ts) and contracts is the only package both the frontend and dashboard server already import, so contracts is the only home that fixes all surfaces with one comparator.

autoDecisions.summary: Implement via a pinned Intl.Collator('en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }) instead of hand-rolled prefix/number parsing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Numeric collation compares embedded digit runs by value, covering standard PREFIX-N ids, Rally TYPENUMBER ids, mixed-width numbers, and non-numeric suffixes without a parser; pinning the 'en' locale keeps ordering deterministic across environments. Simplicity-first per Karpathy rules.

autoDecisions.summary: Surfaces whose primary sort is not the issue id (priority, recency, project name, score) are left untouched; only issue-id comparisons are swapped.
autoDecisions.rationale: The acceptance criteria require preserving existing grouping/secondary semantics; changing primary sorts elsewhere would be scope creep.

autoDecisions.rationale: This is a sort-order bug fix; no Mintlify page, docs/ file, or CLAUDE.md section documents issue-list ordering, so there is no documented surface to update.

items.title: Add shared compareIssueIds comparator to packages/contracts with unit tests

expected_outputs: issue-sort.test.ts passes with all cases green

narrative.Action: Create packages/contracts/src/issue-sort.ts exporting `compareIssueIds(a: string, b: string): number`. Implementation: a module-level `const collator = new Intl.Collator('en', { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });` and `export function compareIssueIds(a: string, b: string): number { return collator.compare(a, b); }` with a doc comment explaining it exists so issue-id sorts are numeric within a prefix (PAN-532 before PAN-2822) and must be used by every surface that sorts issue ids (cites PAN-2831). Re-export it from packages/contracts/src/index.ts alongside the existing exports. Add packages/contracts/src/issue-sort.test.ts (vitest, colocated like artifacts.test.ts) asserting: (1) ['PAN-2822','PAN-806','PAN-538','PAN-532'].sort(compareIssueIds) === ['PAN-532','PAN-538','PAN-806','PAN-2822']; (2) different prefixes group lexicographically (AUR-2 before PAN-1); (3) non-numeric suffix: PAN-532 before PAN-532-hotfix, and PAN-532-hotfix before PAN-538; (4) Rally-style ids sort numerically (F532 before F2822); (5) case-insensitive: pan-5 and PAN-5 compare equal (returns 0). After editing packages/contracts, rebuild it per workspace rules: `cd packages/contracts && npm run build`.

Issues pane: sort features with compareIssueIds in projectsData.groupProjects

expected_outputs: projectsData.test.ts passes, asserting numeric feature order within a project

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/projectsData.ts line ~67 (`features: [...project.features].sort((a, b) => a.issueId.localeCompare(b.issueId))` inside groupProjects), replace the inline comparator with `compareIssueIds` imported from '@overdeck/contracts', i.e. `.sort((a, b) => compareIssueIds(a.issueId, b.issueId))`. Keep the project-level `.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))` unchanged — projects sort by name, only features within a project change. Add a colocated projectsData.test.ts (mirroring pipeline-helpers.test.ts style) exercising groupProjects with features PAN-2822, PAN-532, PAN-806, PAN-538 in one project and asserting the returned features array is in numeric order [PAN-532, PAN-538, PAN-806, PAN-2822], plus asserting projects remain sorted by name.

expected_outputs: frontend vitest suite passes with no new failures

narrative.Action: Three mechanically identical one-line swaps, each importing compareIssueIds from '@overdeck/contracts': (1) src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/MergePolicySection.tsx line ~51: `.sort((a, b) => a.issueId.localeCompare(b.issueId))` → `.sort((a, b) => compareIssueIds(a.issueId, b.issueId))`. (2) src/dashboard/frontend/src/hooks/useSearch.ts line ~146: inside the scored.sort comparator, keep the score comparison as primary and replace only the tiebreak `return a.issue.identifier.localeCompare(b.issue.identifier)` with `return compareIssueIds(a.issue.identifier, b.issue.identifier)`. (3) src/dashboard/frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx line ~529: `[...issueIds].sort()` → `[...issueIds].sort(compareIssueIds)`. Touch nothing else in these files.
